name: Opposite-complex rollover context (cond_b generalization)
mechanism_en: Sink-node entries conditioned on an active OUT episode in an OPPOSITE-risk complex within 15 sessions — the generalized cond_b footprint (money must have somewhere to come from). NOTE: this is the fixed risk-opposite STAND-IN; the true library A1 (pairs drawn from the measured Flow-Routing Matrix / the 6 placebo-surviving cells) requires a routing-pair grammar primitive that does not yet exist — a reviewed grammar addition, tracked in the library. Nothing here is validated; exploratory tier.
mechanism_zh: 对侧风险板块出现活跃流出事件时的汇入节点入场（cond_b 泛化；真正的路由矩阵版本待路由对语法原语）。
lineage: ORACLE_COMPOUND_LIBRARY.md#family-a (stand-in; true A1 pending routing-pair primitive)

name: Cascade breadth conviction multiplier
mechanism_en: Cascade breadth: >=3 DISTINCT same-complex subsector nodes printing OUT onsets within 15 sessions (true node-breadth — an episode-count implementation would let one re-firing node satisfy the gate).
mechanism_zh: 当同一复合体中N>=3个子板块在15个交易日内出现流出启动时，退出的广度是汇节点的信念乘数。

name: Cohesion collapse-rebuild turn
mechanism_en: Washout with coordinated re-entry: cohesion_chg > 0.056, a FIXED PROXY for the panel_m q75 measured 2026-07-04 — NOT itself an FDR-validated threshold (the FDR-surviving group_flow finding was the cohesion_chg LEG at 20d, unrelated to this scalar). Quantile operator = future grammar addition; threshold will drift from q75 as data accrues.
mechanism_zh: 凝聚力在洗盘过程中下降（个股抛售），然后在转折点跃升（协调买入=机构重新入场）。复合条件：洗盘标志激活且凝聚力变化>0.056。

name: Rate-proxy washout with vol-subsiding conditioner
mechanism_en: Rate-proxy sector washouts are buyable only when bond vol (TLT realized vol) is subsiding. Vol-subsiding approximated as tlt_ret_10d rolling-std over 20d crossed_below its own 60d mean. The defensive rotation rates confound weaponized as a conditioner.
mechanism_zh: 利率代理板块的洗盘信号仅在债券波动率（TLT实际波动率）下降时可交易。波动率下降近似为tlt_ret_10d的20日滚动标准差跌破其60日均值。

name: Opposite-complex outflow with local RS repair
mechanism_en: Executes only when capital is recently leaving the opposite complex and the candidate node has just repaired its relative-strength line, so the rule targets nodes showing direct receipt of routed flow rather than buying the outflow event alone.
mechanism_zh: 仅当资金近期正流出对立板块群、且候选节点相对强度线刚刚修复时触发，锁定直接承接轮动资金的节点，而非单纯买入流出事件本身。

name: Same-complex stress survivor
mechanism_en: Executes when multiple same-complex peers have recently moved out but the candidate node still has positive relative strength and persistence, isolating the node that is absorbing capital inside a stressed complex.
mechanism_zh: 当同一板块群内多个同类节点近期流出、但候选节点仍保持正相对强度与持续性时触发，识别在承压板块群中吸纳资金的幸存节点。

name: Quiet leadership persistence
mechanism_en: Executes on nodes with positive relative strength, steady persistence, and low turnover, targeting leadership that is being accumulated without a noisy crowding surge.
mechanism_zh: 在相对强度为正、持续性稳定且换手率偏低的节点上触发，锁定在无喧嚣拥挤情况下被悄然吸筹的领导品种。

name: Group-confirmed RS turn
mechanism_en: Executes when the candidate node crosses into positive relative strength while its internal cohesion and breadth are already firm, requiring the turn to be confirmed by broad participation instead of a single price impulse.
mechanism_zh: 当候选节点在内部凝聚度与广度已然稳固时上穿至正相对强度触发，要求该转折由广泛参与确认，而非单根价格脉冲。

name: Early acceleration repair before chase
mechanism_en: Executes when weekly velocity has turned positive while acceleration is still modest and relative strength is positive, targeting the early repair window before the move becomes an extended acceleration chase.
mechanism_zh: 当周动能转正、但加速度仍温和且相对强度为正时触发，锁定行情演变为过度加速追涨之前的早期修复窗口。

name: Velocity curve inflection
mechanism_en: Executes when short-term velocity rises above medium-term velocity while longer velocity is still weak, targeting a fresh rotation inflection rather than established momentum.
mechanism_zh: 当短期动能上穿中期动能、而长期动能仍疲弱时触发，锁定新鲜的轮动拐点而非已确立的动能。

name: Risk-on breadth-confirmed rotation
mechanism_en: Executes only when the broad market is above its long trend and volatility is not elevated, then requires the candidate node to show positive breadth and relative strength, targeting pro-cyclical allocation periods rather than defensive shock behavior.
mechanism_zh: 仅当大盘位于长期趋势之上且波动率不高时触发，再要求候选节点呈现正广度与相对强度，锁定顺周期配置阶段而非防御性冲击行为。

name: Rate-relief RS repair
mechanism_en: Executes when bonds have recently firmed and the candidate node crosses back into positive relative strength with improving cohesion, targeting sectors that respond to easing rate pressure without relying on a raw washout trigger.
mechanism_zh: 当债券近期企稳、候选节点在凝聚度改善的同时上穿回正相对强度时触发，锁定对利率压力缓解作出反应的板块，而不依赖原始洗盘触发。

name: Leadership after turnover cooling
mechanism_en: Executes when a positive-relative-strength node remains persistent after turnover crosses back below elevated levels, targeting leadership whose crowded burst has cooled without losing sponsorship.
mechanism_zh: 当正相对强度节点在换手率回落至偏高水平之下后仍保持持续性时触发，锁定拥挤脉冲已降温但未失去支撑的领导品种。

name: Internal breadth leads price repair
mechanism_en: Executes when breadth and cohesion are improving while short-term velocity is not yet strong, targeting cases where internal participation improves before price momentum is obvious.
mechanism_zh: 当广度与凝聚度改善、而短期动能尚未走强时触发，锁定内部参与度先于价格动能改善的情形。
